animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 1
animation_items.description: Standing, left hand positioned over upper chest region with fingers slightly curled inward, right hand resting low near hip area. Head oriented downward and slightly turned away from viewer, displaying a restrained posture indicative of unexpected discomfort or social embarrassment consistent with expressions of surprise or shame.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 2
animation_items.description: standing, feet shoulder-width apart with minimal shift in balance. hands raised to chest height, palms facing inward with fingers curved gently, positioned to press against upper torso. head tilted downward and turned slightly away, gaze directed toward ground. subtle body tremors evident in limbs and trunk, conveying internal distress linked to unexpected exposure or social awkwardness.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 3
animation_items.description: Standing with feet shoulder-width apart, body fully upright. Both hands press against the mouth region, fingers curled inward toward the cheeks, palms facing outward. Head remains level without tilt, eyes focused directly forward. The stance conveys immediate shock or embarrassment, blending visible signs of surprise with hidden discomfort suggestive of social anxiety or unintended disclosure.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 4
animation_items.description: The character stands upright with arms fully extended to either side, palms facing outward and fingers relaxed. Both hands rest at approximately waist-level, thumbs pointed downward. Head faces directly forward with no tilt or turn. The stance conveys a mixture of surprise and shame, characterized by unwavering posture and absence of protective gestures typically linked to heightened anxiety or social awkwardness.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 5
animation_items.description: Standing, barefoot. Both hands raised to the face, positioned symmetrically on either side of the nose and mouth, fingers slightly parted with palms facing outward. animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 6

No visible upper-body movement occurs within this stationary stance.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 7

Posture conveys acute reaction to external stimuli coupled with underlying sense of vulnerability or public scrutiny typical of moments involving sudden alarm or social embarrassment.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 8

Posture combines signs of surprise and embarrassment through elevated hands, fixed gaze direction, and rigid body alignment.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 9
animation_items.description: standing, feet shoulder-width apart with balanced weight distribution. Both hands raised to mid-upper chest, fingers gently curved and resting on skin surface; right hand positioned slightly higher than left. Upper body taut with minor muscular engagement, suggesting subconscious protective response. Head maintained vertical alignment without tilt, yet subtle micro-expressions imply abrupt mental shift toward heightened sensitivity or social discomfort characteristic of unanticipated public exposure.

animation_items.name: Surprise/Shame/Etc. 10
animation_items.description: Stationary pose featuring feet shoulder-width apart, balanced and grounded. Right hand raised vertically to forehead with fingers fully extended horizontally, palms facing outward; left hand relaxed at side. Head maintained facing forward but subtly tilted downward, gaze directed away from direct engagement. Stance conveys cautious reserve blended with hints of surprise and vulnerability indicative of encountering an unexpected situation causing personal unease.
